name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 56 - Am 175
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 56 a. Recalls that Danish official statistics show male immigrants from Muslim-majority MENAPT countries (Middle East, North Africa, Pakistan and Turkey) have conviction rates 2,5 times higher than natives, with their descendants over three times higher and over four times higher for violent crime; underlines that EU migration funding must reflect those social costs and prioritise deportations to MENAPT countries;
